name: Way of the Hive
description:
A Colony of insects lives on your body and in your clothing, granting you access to all Way of the Hive Abilities.

The presence of your Colony is off-putting to foes who come near you. Any time you would enter Engagement, first roll Spirit vs Fortitude against your opponent. On a win, you automatically win the Engagement, no rolls required. On a loss, no effect.
successes:
✨: The opponent checks a Condition.

🌞: Win or loss, the opponent's Attack may not proceed.
